story.iWant: a query builder class that handles all PATSTAT interactions
story.soThat: query logic is centralized, testable, and follows consistent patterns

tasks.task: Expand PatstatQueries class structure (AC: 1, 2) Add imports for pandas, sqlalchemy, PATSTAT models Add type hints for all methods Add docstrings following project patterns Define empty DataFrames with correct schemas for error returns

Implement get_trend_data() - Tech Field mode (AC: 3, 4) Build ORM query joining tls201, tls230, tls207, tls206 Apply filters: appln_auth, techn_field_nr, year BETWEEN Filter applt_seq_nr greater than 0 (applicants only) GROUP BY appln_filing_year COUNT(appln_id) for application_count COUNT(DISTINCT docdb_family_id) for invention_count ORDER BY year ASC Execute and convert to DataFrame

Implement get_trend_data() - IPC mode (AC: 3, 5) Build alternative query using tls209_appln_ipc Filter by ipc_class_symbol LIKE for each code Use OR conditions for multiple IPC codes Apply same aggregation logic as tech field mode
Add region filter to get_trend_data() (AC: 6) Check if state.region is not None Add join to tls206_person if not present Add filter: nuts LIKE state.region% Test with DE region code
Add SME filter to get_trend_data() (AC: 7) Create subquery for SME identification Add filter when state.sme_filter is True Consider performance impact of subquery
Implement stub methods for other queries (AC: 2) Add get_top_applicants() stub Add get_tech_breakdown() stub Add get_regional_distribution() stub Document full implementation in Stories 3.2, 3.3
Add error handling (AC: 8) Wrap query execution in try/except Return empty DataFrame with correct schema on error Print error message for debugging Handle connection timeout gracefully

Integration with WidgetFactory (AC: 1-8) Update _on_run_click() to instantiate PatstatQueries Call get_trend_data(state) on run button click Store result in module-level variable for Epic 4 Update progress message during query execution
Validation (AC: 1-8) Test with DE, Field 13, 2019-2023 Test IPC mode with A61B Test with region filter Verify DataFrame schemas Verify query completes within 60 seconds

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: PatstatQueries(db) stores db reference and is ready for query calls
Class has get_trend_data, get_top_applicants, get_tech_breakdown, get_regional_distribution methods returning DataFrames
Returns DataFrame with year, application_count, invention_count grouped by year, respecting all state filters
Uses tls230_appln_techn_field for efficient filtering by techn_field_nr
Uses tls209_appln_ipc with LIKE filtering for each IPC code
Filters by tls206_person.nuts LIKE when state.region is set
Only includes applicants with less than 100 total applications when sme_filter is True
Returns empty DataFrame with correct schema on error, logs error message

constraints.constraint: ORM primary for simple queries, SQL escape hatch for complex aggregations
Prevention by Design: state.is_valid() already validated before queries run
Use appln_auth (filing jurisdiction) for country filtering, not person_ctry_code
Queries must complete within 60 seconds for 5-year spans
Filter applt_seq_nr greater than 0 to get applicants only (exclude inventors)
Use psn_name for applicant grouping (PATSTAT standardized names)
